newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan March domestic output up 17% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nissan March domestic output up 17% yr/yr.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Monday that its domestic vehicle production rose 17.0 percent in March from a year earlier to 177,314 vehicles.
Nissan's exports rose 5.3 percent in March from a year earlier to 51,725 vehicles. Its domestic sales rose 3.2 percent in March from a year earlier to 178,880 units.
Its domestic production rose for a third successive month on a year-on-year basis, reflecting higher domestic sales and exports.
Its vehicle exports rose for a seventh straight month due to higher exports to Asia, Oceania and the Middle East, a Nissan spokesman said.

Nissan's domestic sales rose for a fifth consecutive month, reflecting good demand for its new recreational vehicles and remodelled cars such as the Stagea, Rasheen and Cima, he said. Its overseas output rose for the ninth straight month, reflecting higher output at its Mexican and British units.
